column1: # Golden reference data for the ITU-T T.61 (11/1988) codec.
# Source: CCITT Recommendation T.61 (11/1988): Table 1 (primary set G0),
# Table 2 (supplementary set G2), Fig. 2 Note 4 (receive-only 0x23 and
# 0x24), Fig. 3 (control functions), Fig. B-1 (diacritic + base letter
# SPACE spacing accents), and the design decisions D2 and D3 (aliases
# of the Greek capital omega and the capital eth).
# This file is hand-transcribed from the specification. It is an
# INDEPENDENT copy of the code tables and must NEVER be generated from
# the t61codec package: a refactoring must not be able to change a
# Format: UTF-8, LF line endings, no BOM. Tab-separated, six columns,
# exactly one header line (the first line that does not start with '#').
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#   kind        control | g0 | g2 | combination | spacing_accent |
#   bytes       space-separated uppercase hex bytes in T.61, e.g. C2 65
#   codepoints  space-separated Unicode code points, e.g. U+00E9
#               decode  : receive only, decoded but never emitted
#               encode  : encode only, never produced by decoding
#   note        optional, human-readable (character name and glyph)
# Review: every row can be checked against the cited table on its own.
# Rows are grouped by kind and ordered as in the specification.
